# apple_submit_app_store_version_experiment (Action)

Submits a product page optimization experiment to App Review, by adding it to the review submission of its app and platform that is being prepared, or a new one. An experiment needs review when its treatments have metadata of their own.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_app_store_version_experiment" "icons" {
  config {
    experiment_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment.icons.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `experiment_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_experiment.example.id`.

### Optional

- `submit` (Boolean) Whether to submit the review submission. Set it to `false` to add other items to the same submission. Defaults to `true`.
